Unmodified encoder: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
Corresponding source: npm package lamejs@1.2.1 (pinned in package-lock.json).
The standalone encoder is loaded only in the export Worker and can be replaced
with a compatible build at /daw/vendor/lame.min.js. See LAMEJS-LICENSE.txt.
